import numpy as np
# Baseline subtraction: linear between mean(1090-1110) and mean(1790-1810)
mask_base1 = (x >= 1090) & (x <= 1110)
mask_base2 = (x >= 1790) & (x <= 1810)
b1 = np.mean(y1[mask_base1])
b2 = np.mean(y1[mask_base2])
baseline = np.interp(x, [1100, 1800], [b1, b2])
y1_bl = y1 - baseline
# Normalize by G-band max (1550-1620 cm-1)
mask_g = (x >= 1550) & (x <= 1620)
g_max = np.max(y1_bl[mask_g])
if g_max > 0:
    y1_norm = y1_bl / g_max
else:
    y1_norm = y1_bl
y1 = y1_norm
